Show

Drag the orbit view to rotate it, scroll or pinch to zoom. Drag the Moon to move it around its orbit. Double-click the Sun, Earth or Moon to centre on it.

Keyboard shortcuts

T Esc
Reset the orbit view
Based on the "Phases of the Moon" poster by Oliver Cohen (7D). Earth: NASA Blue Marble (public domain). Moon: Solar System Scope, based on NASA data (CC BY 4.0). Coastlines: Natural Earth (public domain).
This simulator needs WebGL, which isn't available in this browser or on this device.
